_description: Payload exported from a third-party building management system alert log. None of the field names match the canonical ingestion contract (no timestamp alias, no asset alias, no sensor_values). The normalizer raises missing_timestamp for every item. All items fail; the batch returns HTTP 422 with no rows ingested.
_expected: HTTP 422, type: validation_error, all items fail normalization, 0 rows ingested
_operator_note: This is the 'wrong export format' failure mode. Operator exported an alert log instead of a telemetry log. Fix: export the raw sensor time-series from the source system, not the alert event table.
